predecessors.name: Karkota dynasty
predecessors.text: all of the Karkota kingdom: 'Founded by Avantivarman in 855, it replaced the Karkota dynasty'

successors.name: Lohara dynasty
successors.text: Kashmir: Didda 'adopted a nephew, Samgrāmarāja ... to be her heir in Kashmir.

ledger.x: 855: Avantivarman founds the Utpala dynasty in Kashmir.
860 (bridge): the Jammu and Himachal side of Cliopatria's 860 jump in the Kashmir row.
8 August 1003: Didda dies and the Utpala line ends.

wars.name: Shankaravarman's invasion of Gujarat
wars.outcome: 'Kalhana notes that Sankaravarman invaded Gujarat with an army composed of nine lac infantrymen, three hundred elephants and one lac cavalry'; 'Alakhana, the local ruler had to gift a swath of territory to maintain his sovereignty'.

wars.name: Tantrin and Damara revolts
wars.outcome: Partha 'was finally overthrown by the Tantrins' in 921; Chakravarman restored in 935 and had to flee again; 'their combined forces took on Sambhuvardhana in the spring of 936 near Padmapura' (Pampore); 'In the summer of 937, a group of Damara guards attacked…

certainty.note: No treaty line or border appears on either page; only Valley towns and Lohara are named.
